name: Override: the lift at every height
description: Moves the lift to each of its nine heights with the drive still, so the report gives how long each move takes: 0.12 to 0.45 s between neighbouring heights, 1.00 s from Over a stack on a Neutral Goal to Top, and 1.53 s from Top back down. A lift step gets 1.5 s unless you change it, so the last step has a 2.5 s time limit. At Top the robot is 49.94 in tall; the limit is 50 in. Use the times to place lift actions in a drive.

steps.note: as high as the lift goes
all the way back down; 40 in takes longer than the 1.5 s a lift step gets
